1 import SixVertexUnfolding.CanonicalSixGraphs
2 
3 /-! Explicit candidate and actual facet vertex sets for the four six-vertex graphs. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind
6 
7 /-- The original edges in the canonical labeling. -/
8 def adjacent (kind : SixGraphKind) (i j : Fin 6) : Prop :=
9   i ≠ j ∧ s(i, j) ∉ kind.missingEdges
10 
11 instance (kind : SixGraphKind) : DecidableRel kind.adjacent := fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs
12   (Decidable (_ ≠ _ ∧ _ ∉ kind.missingEdges))
13 
14 /-- A triangle is complete; a quadrilateral has exactly two neighbors at each corner. -/
15 def isPolygon (kind : SixGraphKind) (vertices : Finset (Fin 6)) : Prop :=
16   (vertices.card = 3 ∧ ∀ a ∈ vertices, ∀ b ∈ vertices, a ≠ b → kind.adjacent a b) ∨
17   (vertices.card = 4 ∧ ∀ a ∈ vertices, (vertices.filter (kind.adjacent a)).card = 2)
18 
19 instance (kind : SixGraphKind) (vertices : Finset (Fin 6)) : Decidable (kind.isPolygon vertices) :=
20   inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((_ ∧ _) ∨ (_ ∧ _)))
21 
22 /-- All triangles and induced quadrilaterals of each graph, including potential nonfacial cycles. -/
23 def candidates : SixGraphKind → Finset (Finset (Fin 6))
24   | .octahedron => {{0, 2, 4}, {0, 2, 5}, {0, 3, 4}, {0, 3, 5},
25       {1, 2, 4}, {1, 2, 5}, {1, 3, 4}, {1, 3, 5}, {0, 1, 2, 3}, {0, 1, 4, 5}, {2, 3, 4, 5}}
26   | .minusEdge => {{0, 2, 4}, {0, 2, 5}, {0, 3, 4}, {0, 3, 5},
27       {1, 3, 4}, {1, 3, 5}, {0, 1, 4, 5}, {1, 2, 4, 5}, {2, 3, 4, 5}}
28   | .prismDiagonal => {{0, 2, 4}, {0, 2, 5}, {0, 3, 5}, {1, 3, 5},
29       {0, 1, 3, 4}, {0, 1, 4, 5}, {1, 2, 4, 5}}
30   | .prism => {{0, 2, 4}, {1, 3, 5}, {0, 1, 3, 4}, {0, 2, 3, 5}, {1, 2, 4, 5}}
31 
32 /-- The vertex sets of the original facets; auxiliary diagonals are not edges here. -/
33 def facets : SixGraphKind → Finset (Finset (Fin 6))
34   | .octahedron => {{0, 2, 4}, {0, 2, 5}, {0, 3, 4}, {0, 3, 5},
35       {1, 2, 4}, {1, 2, 5}, {1, 3, 4}, {1, 3, 5}}
36   | .minusEdge => {{0, 2, 4}, {0, 2, 5}, {0, 3, 4}, {0, 3, 5},
37       {1, 3, 4}, {1, 3, 5}, {1, 2, 4, 5}}
38   | .prismDiagonal => {{0, 2, 4}, {0, 2, 5}, {0, 3, 5}, {1, 3, 5}, {0, 1, 3, 4}, {1, 2, 4, 5}}
39   | .prism => {{0, 2, 4}, {1, 3, 5}, {0, 1, 3, 4}, {0, 2, 3, 5}, {1, 2, 4, 5}}
40 
41 set_option maxRecDepth 10000 in
42 set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
43 /-- Exhaust the 64 subsets of the six original vertices, using ordinary kernel reduction. -/
44 theorem isPolygon_iff_candidate : ∀ (kind : SixGraphKind) (vertices : Finset (Fin 6)),
45     kind.isPolygon vertices ↔ vertices ∈ kind.candidates := by decide
46 
47 end SixVertexUnfolding.SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind
